title: Transaction Isolation Levels and Anomalies in PostgreSQL
description:
Transaction isolation levels are one of those topics that many developers use every day — but don’t really understand.
In this video, I break them down using transaction anomalies:
what they mean, what’s strange about them, and how they define each isolation level.
By the end, you’ll understand how anomalies and isolation levels are connected,
and why databases behave the way they do under concurrent transactions.
